scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:chrome && npm run test:firefox
scripts.test:install: puppeteer browsers install chrome && puppeteer browsers install firefox && node -e "require('geckodriver').download().then(console.log)"
scripts.build: spago bundle-app --to static/settings.js && npm run uglify
scripts.uglify: terser static/settings.js --compress --mangle --output static/settings.min.js && mv static/settings.min.js static/settings.js
scripts.pack-source: zip -r ./switch-to-audible-tab-source.zip img src scripts manifest.json manifest.chrome.json README.md DEVELOPMENT.md package.json package-lock.json static spago.dhall packages.dhall .gitignore LICENSE
